notes: All quantities are SI, float64. tidal_column and the tensors are rounded to 10 significant digits (they need log and atan, which are not correctly rounded everywhere); everything else is written with full precision.
Rays start at observer.position; direction is a unit vector in scene axes.
chords: path length of the ray inside each object's FULL shape (children included), not its own region.
tidal_column: integral of rho dr / r beyond observer.exclusion (scenes/README.md).

sensors: the tidal tensor E_ij = d_i d_j Phi at nine points around the observer, from the closed-form fields of uniform boxes and spheres; tensor_without_room leaves out the objects marked background.
